author: alexstrel
body:
This is a hot fix PR. It adjusts the `ConstructLinks` kernel launch configuration to reduce the per-block register pressure and avoid `cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources` error.

The change is needed to address https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/51860, where `PFMultiDepthClusterSoAProducer` fails in high-pileup TTbar workflows on several NVIDIA GPUs, including T4, L40S, and H100.

Validated with 
`runTheMatrix.py -w gpu -l 37634.422`
title: Adjusted kernel launch parameters to reduce per-block register pressure
